shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, CE bridge (experimental), "Traveler" climb animations, blueprint art, wall risers, research-gated links, a per-colony off switch, Perspective Shift + Toggleable Overlays support. Window 11 SHIPPED to Workshop 3776015553. Window 12 open: cross-level ability/jump targeting fixed (§82), awaiting field verification.
body:
**NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §0 handover; §1-19 architecture; §20 compat; §21-29 bug records; §30 SUPERSEDED by §62; §31 publishing + GIT; §32-40 records; §41-44 combat/senses/travel/CE; §51 Celestial Lighting; §52 field-report round 2; §53 arrival/landing; §54 structure fit; §55 exit grid; §56 Geological Landforms; §57 stale decoration window; §58 relocated-structure fog; §59 forbid-aware islands; §60 area-linear vanilla systems; §61 camera-mod coexistence; §62 utility COLUMN rework + §62.N; §63 stairs permission; §64 cross-level shadow depth; §65 forbidden mirroring; §66 aim/wild-miss/aim-pie; §67 boulder extrusion; §68 KCSG/VFEM2; §69 stair temperature; §70 band flora legality + §70.B (OPEN); §71 Smooth Terrain (RESOLVED; report awaiting paste); §72 link gizmos; §73 transit animations (SUPERSEDED); §74 blueprint art; §75 wall risers; §76 Perspective Shift; §77 motion study + §77b railing bug + §77c art defects; §78 pre-hop delay + climb grammar; §79 Toggleable Overlays; §80 research gating; §81 multiple-levels checkbox; **§82 cross-level ability/jump targeting (window 12, BUILT, NOT FIELD-VERIFIED)**. Keep every ⚠.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> **⚠⚠ V1 SOURCE IS NOT GONE. DATED SOURCE BACKUPS LIVE AT `D:\Rimworld\As above, So below\<yyyymmdd-hhmmss>\Source\`** (ten snapshots, newest `20260726-154207`). The old note "V1 survives only in git history pre-a50a744" was WRONG and cost a re-derivation. These are `Source/` only - no Defs, no Textures. **When a V2 feature has a V1 ancestor, READ THE V1 FILE FIRST.** Confirmed useful: `Source/Stairs/ClimbAnimation.cs` (§78d). Tool boundary: `read` refuses that path, `bash`/`grep`/`sed` reach it fine.

# 0. START HERE

**CURRENT PHASE: BUILD MODE, WINDOW 12 OPEN. §82 IS BUILT AND UNVERIFIED - IT IS THE ONE THING IN FLIGHT.**

**WINDOW 11 IS SHIPPED** to Workshop 3776015553 and was the cleanest window yet: all four features field-verified before upload, zero bridge errors across both runs. Pushed as **`93a8311`**; the six stripped items are restored and the post-restore build is green.

**⚠ WORKSPACE DLL IS A DEBUG BUILD** (`build_mod` builds Debug). Re-run `dotnet build -c Release` in `Source/` before any publish.

**⚠ THE ONE THING WINDOW 11 DID NOT DO: THE WORKSHOP SMOKE TEST.** Still never done for any window. Every verification to date has been against the WORKSPACE copy; nobody has ever subscribed to the uploaded item and loaded it. That is the one class of fault this project is structurally blind to.

**⚠ OPEN, NOT URGENT:** **FINAL riser art** (Gemini PAUSED r5; ⚠ REWRITE prompts to the REAL palette - NO copper: power=steel+blue+hazard, pipe=pale+red valve, climate=ice+louver+orange, data=black+purple+cyan; the 12 shipped riser PNGs are placeholders by explicit user decision). **§77c ART** - grand staircase east/west sprites unrotated; user's domain. **ABOUT.XML DESCRIPTION IS STALE** (no research gating, no off switch) - USER'S COPY, flagged not fixed. **`About/known-issues.json`** has shipped unchanged since window 8.

**⚠ SHIPPED KNOWINGLY UNVERIFIED (earlier windows, still true):** §62.N, §70 (w8); §62.M, §66c, §66e (w7).

**⚠ USER WORKING RULES:** (1) NEVER source design ideas from other mods unless asked - scans COMPAT ONLY. **V1 is OUR OWN prior work and is exempt: porting from it is explicitly wanted.** (2) Building art = USER via Nano Banana kits. (3) About.xml description = USER's copy. (4) N mockups = N CHOICES.

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE FIFTY-ONE RULES:** 1. CLAMP AT SELECTION. 2. NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`. 3. REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER: flood CELLS. 4. COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/ENGINE STACKS. 5 (§48): A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 (§49): A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP INSTEAD OF AN ERROR. 7 (§52): THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD. 8 (§52.6): A LOAD-TIME REPAIR PASS MUST NEVER RE-CREATE WHAT THE PLAYER DELIBERATELY REMOVED. 9 (§53): SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 (§54): A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 (§55): A CELL-LEVEL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN-LEVEL ACTION. 12 (§56a): A FOREIGN MOD'S MAP-SIZE SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 (§56g): NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 (§56m): BEFORE RELOCATING DATA, ASK WHAT IS ALREADY AT THE DESTINATION. 15 (§57i): ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 (§56o): COUNT THE FOREIGN MOD'S WRITE PATHS. 17 (§56q): A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX. 18 (§57a): NEVER EXONERATE A SUSPECT ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 (§57f): `TicksGame` RESTARTS AT 0 EVERY NEW GAME. 20 (§57g): MOVING WORK EARLIER TURNS ON EVERY "IS THIS MAP READY" GATE. 21 (§58): THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL WITH THE CONTENT. 22 (§59): A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN IN IT. 23 (§60): AUDIT THE WEIGHTING, NOT THE SYMBOL. 24 (§61a): CLAMPING A VALUE WITHOUT CLAMPING ITS TARGET BUILDS AN OSCILLATOR. 25 (§61b): A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS AFTER THE OBJECT WAS ALREADY POSITIONED. 26 (§61f): EVERY READ OF THE MAP THE PLAYER CAN REACH MUST PASS THE RENDERER'S "IS IT DRAWN" GATE. 27 (§62c): PREFER SPAWN/DESPAWN OVER FLICK. 28 (§63a): A PERMANENT FICTION INSTALLED FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS READ AS FACT BY EVERY OTHER ONE. 29 (§0b): REPORT OUTCOMES, NOT INTENTIONS. 30 (§66d): A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN, NOT A NUMBER. 31 (§66f): MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE DECLINED. 32 (§69a): TURNING OFF A TICK TURNS OFF EVERY SERVICE THAT RODE ON IT. 33 (§62k): A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO. 34 (§62l): AN INVISIBLE THING IS ABSENT FROM EVERY SECTION LAYER. 35 (§62n): A CLONED FOREIGN DEF MADE VISIBLE IS IN NONE OF THE HOST'S OWN LOOKUPS. 36 (§70a): RUN VANILLA'S OWN LEGALITY PREDICATE. 37 (§71a): NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT BEFORE NAMING THE SYMPTOM. 38 (§73): WHEN A SPRITE MUST APPEAR AWAY FROM ITS THING'S POSITION, OWN THE DRAW. 39 (§76): WINNING THE LAST WRITE DOES NOT SETTLE A DISAGREEMENT ABOUT THE TARGET. 40 (§75.h): A TRIPWIRE THAT FIRES BEFORE THE OBSERVER ATTACHES IS NOT A TRIPWIRE. 41 (§77a): A STRUCT FIELD YOU NEVER SET IS A FEATURE YOU NEVER SHIPPED. 42 (§77b): THE DIRECTION A MOTION READS AS IS A PROPERTY OF THE THING, NOT OF THE ARRIVAL. 43 (§78): **DEFER THE MOVE, NEVER THE DECISION.** 44 (§78b): AN OFFSET APPLIED WHOLE ON FRAME ONE IS A TELEPORT. 45 (§78d): **A DIRECTION OF TRAVEL IS NOT A DIRECTION OF ELEVATION.** 46 (§78d): **NON-UNIFORM SCALE x ROTATION = SHEAR.** 47 (§79): **A FOREIGN MOD'S CACHED CURSOR CELL IS AN ASSUMPTION ABOUT COORDINATE SPACE.** 48 (§81a): **A WRITE THAT IS READ BACK BY ITS OWN CALLER IS NOT A WRITE.** 49 (§0c): **A TEST THAT PROVES FEATURE A SAYS NOTHING ABOUT FEATURE B, AND "TESTS GOOD" IS NOT A SCOPE.** 50 (§82a): **TWO OF OUR OWN PATCHES ON ONE VANILLA METHOD CANCEL SILENTLY.** Harmony hands a POSTFIX the arguments AS THE PREFIX LEFT THEM, so our own prefix that rewrites an argument is consumed by our own postfix that reads it - no error, no log line, feature simply absent. **GREP OUR OWN `[HarmonyPatch(...)]` LIST FOR THE TARGET METHOD BEFORE ADDING A PATCH TO IT.** 51 (§82b): **A FACTORY HAS USUALLY CONSUMED ITS INPUT BY THE TIME THE POSTFIX RUNS.** `PawnFlyer.MakeFlyer` despawns the pawn before returning it, so a postfix guard of `if (!pawn.Spawned) return;` is ALWAYS taken and `pawn.Map` is always null. Capture in a PREFIX via `__state`.

# 82. CROSS-LEVEL TARGETING FOR JUMPS, ABILITIES AND PSYCASTS — WINDOW 12, BUILT, **NOT FIELD-VERIFIED**

User report: *"Jumping and abilities and psycasts don't properly target across levels and click through the air tiles. When you lower the camera to the level you want to interact with, they fire fine but the pathfinding isn't patched so they instead jump across the entirety of the map until they reach the slice the target was on."* Two unrelated defects behind one report; both are OUR bugs, neither is a missing feature.

**⚠⚠ 82a. THE TARGETING HALF: WE HAD TWO PATCHES ON `GenUI.TargetsAt` AND THEY CANCELLED (rule 50).**
`Patch_GenUI_ABTargetsAtThroughFloor` (a PREFIX in `ABUIGeometry.cs`, window 8) rewrote `clickPos` down to the visible band. `Patch_GenUI_ABTargetsAtSeeThrough` (a POSTFIX in `ABCombatTargeting.cs`, window 9) substituted the yielded CELL for the one the column shows. Vanilla's `TargetsAt` resolves THINGS from the `clickPos` argument but the bare CELL from `UI.MouseCell()` - which no prefix can reach - so:
* the prefix could only ever fix the thing half;
* Harmony hands a postfix the arguments **as the prefix left them**, so the postfix asked "is this cell open air?" about an already-descended cell that is normally solid floor, got NO, and declined to substitute.

Net effect, shipped since window 9: you could point a psycast at a **pawn** one level down, and every **cell**-targeted verb - jump packs, `Verb_CastAbilityJump`, Skip's destination, any location psycast - resolved onto the raw sky cell, where `JumpUtility.ValidJumpTarget` refuses (open air is Impassable) and `Verb_Jump.OnGUI` draws the red `TexCommand.CannotShoot` cursor. **FIX: the prefix is DELETED**, with a tombstone comment in `ABUIGeometry.cs`; the pair of postfixes is now the only see-through target rule. Do not reinstate it.

**82.2 THE GATE MOVED FROM COMBAT TO RENDERING.** `ABCombatTargeting.TryResolveClicked` was behind `ABCombatV2.Enabled` (= `ABGuard.Combat`) while the renderer, the right-click translation and select-through are all behind `ABGuard.Rendering`. With the prefix gone the thing half would have inherited the combat switch, so a fault in the shot solver would have taken away the player's ability to POINT at the level below. "Which cell am I pointing at" is a DRAWN question; whether the result can be hit is still ABShaft's call, still behind the combat guard.

**⚠⚠ 82b. THE LEAP HALF: `PawnFlyer.MakeFlyer` DESPAWNS THE PAWN BEFORE IT RETURNS (rule 51).**
`Patch_PawnFlyer_ABCrossBandArc` was a lone POSTFIX opening with `if (!pawn.Spawned) return;`. MakeFlyer's last acts are `pawn.DeSpawn(DestroyMode.WillReplace)` then `innerContainer.TryAdd(pawn)`, so that guard was taken **on every call since window 8** and `pawn.Map` was null anyway. The patch had never run once. **It is now a PREFIX that captures an `Origin __state` while the pawn is still alive, plus a postfix that applies it.**

**82.3 IT WAS NOT A COSMETIC PATCH, WHICH IS WHY IT READ AS "PATHFINDING".** Two vanilla behaviours hang off the two fields it writes:
* `PawnFlyer.RecomputePosition` ends with `base.Position = groundPos.ToIntVec3()`, so the flyer's REAL cell walks the lerp - the pawn is genuinely dragged a whole Slot across the gutter and every intervening level. That is the user's "jump across the entirety of the map until they reach the slice the target was on", literally.
* `SpawnSetup` turns `flightDistance` (`pawn.Position.DistanceTo(destCell)`, computed raw inside MakeFlyer) into `ticksFlightTime`, so the leap also took tens of seconds. **Both are corrected**: `startVec` is translated into the destination band keeping its in-band offset, and `flightDistance` is recomputed band-local. Reproducing vanilla's `overrideStartVec ?? pawn.TrueCenter()` in the prefix means an overridden start (PitBurrow, fleshbeast emergences) is translated too rather than overwritten.

**82.4 THE VERIFICATION SCRIPT (nothing here has been run).** Banded map, dev mode. (1) From the level ABOVE, hover a jump pack / jump ability over an open-air cell that shows floor below: the cursor must be the normal target box, not the red circle; click it and the pawn must arc a SHORT hop inside the lower band, arriving in about a second. (2) Same hover with a cell-targeted psycast (Skip destination is the sharpest test - it also exercises `CompAbilityEffect_WithDest`). (3) Same with a pawn-targeted psycast, to confirm deleting the prefix did not cost the thing half. (4) `AB2: combat report` should show `targeting: seeThroughCells` climbing while hovering and `leaps: crossBand` incrementing per jump - **both counters read zero for the entire shipped life of the bug**, so they are the cheap regression check.

**82.5 WHAT WAS AUDITED AND FOUND ALREADY CORRECT** (do not re-derive): `JobDriver_CastJump` is `JobDriver_CastVerbOnceStatic` - `StopDead` then cast, it never paths; `Toils_Combat.GotoCastPosition` bails on a cell target and otherwise goes through `CastPositionFinder.TryFindCastPosition`, which §ABCombatPosition already prefixes; `JumpUtility.OrderJump` calls `BestOrderedGotoDestNear` with `reachable: false`, which `Patch_RCellFinder_ABOrderedGotoBand` already exempts. **Not audited:** other ability comps that re-implement range or LoS instead of delegating to the verb, the way `CompAbilityEffect_WithDest` did (ledger 14).

**82.6 THE FLYER IS DRAWN IN THE DESTINATION BAND FOR THE WHOLE ARC.** By construction, since both endpoints now live there. Viewed from the level above, the leap is visible only through the opening. A lifted in-transit draw (the §73/§78 treatment) was deliberately NOT built - note it if the field report asks for one.
